name: JRDB Edge v0.3 B2b frozen gate via Issue

on:
  issues:
    types: [opened]

permissions:
  actions: read
  contents: read
  issues: write

jobs:
  gate:
    if: >-
      github.event.issue.user.login == 'yukki0113' &&
      startsWith(github.event.issue.title, '[JRDB_EDGE_V03_B2B_GATE]')
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30

    steps:
      - name: Checkout latest main
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: main
          fetch-depth: 1

      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.12'

      - name: Parse request
        env:
          ISSUE_BODY: ${{ github.event.issue.body }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          python - <<'PY'
          import json, os, re
          from pathlib import Path

          req=json.loads((os.environ.get('ISSUE_BODY') or '').strip())
          required={
              'b2a_run_id','b2a_artifact_name',
              'b2a_statistical_edges_sha256','b2a_summary_sha256',
              'policy_blob_sha'
          }
          missing=sorted(required-set(req))
          if missing:
              raise SystemExit(f'missing required fields: {missing}')
          sha256_re=re.compile(r'[0-9a-f]{64}')
          sha1_re=re.compile(r'[0-9a-f]{40}')
          for field in ('b2a_statistical_edges_sha256','b2a_summary_sha256'):
              if not sha256_re.fullmatch(str(req[field]).lower()):
                  raise SystemExit(f'invalid {field}')
          if not sha1_re.fullmatch(str(req['policy_blob_sha']).lower()):
              raise SystemExit('invalid policy_blob_sha')
          if not isinstance(req['b2a_run_id'],int) or req['b2a_run_id']<=0:
              raise SystemExit('b2a_run_id must be positive')
          Path('/tmp/request.json').write_text(
              json.dumps(req,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2,sort_keys=True)+'\n',
              encoding='utf-8'
          )
          with Path(os.environ['GITHUB_ENV']).open('a',encoding='utf-8') as f:
              for key,value in req.items():
                  if isinstance(value,(str,int)):
                      f.write(f'{key.upper()}={value}\n')
          PY

      - name: Verify frozen policy and focused tests
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          POLICY_PATH=horse-racing/jrdb/config/jrdb_edge_v03_statistical_gate_policy_shadow.json
          ACTUAL_BLOB="$(git rev-parse "HEAD:$POLICY_PATH")"
          test "$ACTUAL_BLOB" = "$POLICY_BLOB_SHA"
          python -m pip install --disable-pip-version-check -q pytest
          PYTHONPATH=horse-racing/jrdb/src python -m pytest -q \
            horse-racing/jrdb/tests/test_apply_jrdb_edge_v03_statistical_gates_shadow.py

      - name: Download and verify Stage-B2a artifact
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          mkdir -p /tmp/b2a
          gh run download "$B2A_RUN_ID" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" \
            --name "$B2A_ARTIFACT_NAME" --dir /tmp/b2a
          mapfile -t statistical < <(find /tmp/b2a -type f -name statistical_edges.jsonl -print)
          mapfile -t summaries < <(find /tmp/b2a -type f -name summary.json -print)
          test "${#statistical[@]}" -eq 1
          test "${#summaries[@]}" -eq 1
          cp "${statistical[0]}" /tmp/b2a_statistical_edges.jsonl
          cp "${summaries[0]}" /tmp/b2a_summary.json
          echo "$B2A_STATISTICAL_EDGES_SHA256  /tmp/b2a_statistical_edges.jsonl" | sha256sum -c -
          echo "$B2A_SUMMARY_SHA256  /tmp/b2a_summary.json" | sha256sum -c -
          python - <<'PY'
          import json
          summary=json.load(open('/tmp/b2a_summary.json'))
          if summary.get('status')!='PASS':
              raise SystemExit('Stage-B2a summary is not PASS')
          if summary.get('stage')!='B2A_STATISTICAL_DIAGNOSTICS':
              raise SystemExit('Stage-B2a stage mismatch')
          if summary.get('mode')!='SHADOW_ONLY':
              raise SystemExit('Stage-B2a mode mismatch')
          if summary.get('threshold_policy')!='NOT_FROZEN':
              raise SystemExit('Stage-B2a threshold policy mismatch')
          PY

      - name: Apply frozen Stage-B2b Performance gate
        env:
          PYTHONPATH: horse-racing/jrdb/src
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          mkdir -p /tmp/gate
          python horse-racing/jrdb/src/apply_jrdb_edge_v03_statistical_gates_shadow.py \
            --policy horse-racing/jrdb/config/jrdb_edge_v03_statistical_gate_policy_shadow.json \
            --b2a-jsonl /tmp/b2a_statistical_edges.jsonl \
            --b2a-summary /tmp/b2a_summary.json \
            --output-jsonl /tmp/gate/gated_edges.jsonl \
            --output-summary /tmp/gate/summary.json
          cp /tmp/request.json /tmp/gate/request.json
          cp /tmp/b2a_summary.json /tmp/gate/b2a_summary.json
          cp horse-racing/jrdb/config/jrdb_edge_v03_statistical_gate_policy_shadow.json \
            /tmp/gate/gate_policy.json

      - name: Upload frozen gate audit
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: jrdb-edge-v03-b2b-gate-${{ github.run_id }}
          path: /tmp/gate/
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 30
          compression-level: 6

      - name: Comment result and close
        if: success()
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          ISSUE_NUMBER: ${{ github.event.issue.number }}
          RUN_ID: ${{ github.run_id }}
          HEAD_SHA: ${{ github.sha }}
        run: |
          python - <<'PY'
          import json, os, subprocess
          result=json.load(open('/tmp/gate/summary.json'))
          compact={
              'status':result['status'],
              'stage':result['stage'],
              'run_id':int(os.environ['RUN_ID']),
              'head_sha':os.environ['HEAD_SHA'],
              'artifact_name':f"jrdb-edge-v03-b2b-gate-{os.environ['RUN_ID']}",
              'policy_id':result['policy_id'],
              'policy_sha256':result['policy_sha256'],
              'input_rows':result['input_rows'],
              'shadow_class_counts':result['shadow_class_counts'],
              'incremental_performance_pass':result['incremental_performance_pass'],
              'incremental_performance_pass_rate':result['incremental_performance_pass_rate'],
              'pass_template_counts':result['pass_template_counts'],
              'pass_direction_counts':result['pass_direction_counts'],
              'pass_reversal_vs_v02':result['pass_reversal_vs_v02'],
              'failed_check_counts':result['failed_check_counts'],
              'value_gate':result['value_gate'],
              'threshold_policy':result['threshold_policy'],
              'mode':'SHADOW_ONLY',
          }
          body='JRDB_EDGE_V03_B2B_GATE_RESULT\n'+json.dumps(
              compact,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2,sort_keys=True
          )
          subprocess.run(
              ['gh','issue','comment',os.environ['ISSUE_NUMBER'],'--repo',
               os.environ['GITHUB_REPOSITORY'],'--body',body],
              check=True
          )
          subprocess.run(
              ['gh','issue','close',os.environ['ISSUE_NUMBER'],'--repo',
               os.environ['GITHUB_REPOSITORY'],'--reason','completed'],
              check=True
          )
          PY

      - name: Comment failure
        if: failure()
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          ISSUE_NUMBER: ${{ github.event.issue.number }}
          RUN_ID: ${{ github.run_id }}
        run: |
          gh issue comment "$ISSUE_NUMBER" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" \
            --body "JRDB Edge v0.3 Stage-B2b frozen gate failed. No production serving was changed. Run: $GITHUB_SERVER_URL/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/actions/runs/$RUN_ID"
